en: The Pokémon World Tournament is through here. The grounds and the hall are open, and the first tournament is about to begin.
Gym Leaders and Champions from every region, battling in one place... I can't wait for it to open!
text: Lideri de Arene și Campioni din fiecare regiune, luptându-se într-un singur loc... Abia aștept să se deschidă!
